service.description: Sends every active digest that is due now in its tenant's zone (past its send time, on its weekday when weekly, not sent yet that day), each claimed first so it goes out once a day.

parameter.name: nowStamp
parameter.description: The moment to judge "due" at; pinned by tests, now otherwise.

parameter.name: outcomes
parameter.description: Per digest: auditDigestId, sent, and the reason when not sent (NOT_YET, NOT_TODAY, SENT_TODAY, NO_DESTINATION, NO_REPORT, DELIVERY_FAILED, BAD_SEND_TIME, FAILED).

service.description: DAR-BE-207. The update after an audit run, on for every audit: by email with one CSV per rule with open findings to every current member of the tenant plus each run digest's (kind AUDDK_RUN) addresses, and a summary card in a digest's chat space. An inactive run digest turns it off; an audit with none gets a default one, which holds the run's claim. Called in the background after every execution of the audit's automations; sends only once the whole audit is idle (nothing running, queued for a retry or waiting for a slot), each digest claimed for the run first so it goes out once. Internal only; anonymous-all, the execute#Automation pattern, because it runs on a background thread with no user and every read it makes carries the tenant explicitly.

parameter.name: reportDate
parameter.description: The run's morning; blank reads it off the audit's latest check run.

parameter.name: period
parameter.description: The period the run recorded (a play's last window).

parameter.name: finishedAutomationId
parameter.description: The automation whose execution just ended; its own RunAdmission slot does not count as busy.

parameter.name: outcomes
parameter.description: Per run digest: auditDigestId, sent, and the reason when not sent (RUN_NOT_DONE, ALREADY_SENT, NO_DESTINATION, NO_REPORT, DELIVERY_FAILED, FAILED).

set.from: darpan.audit.AuditRunUpdateSupport.send(ec, companyUserGroupId, auditId, reportDate, period, finishedAutomationId, nowStamp)
